title: hive-word revise: request body
description: Writes the next revision of an outstanding question, whole: its text, consequence, options and recommendation. The question keeps its identity, its round and its hold, and nothing is released. Only a question with no applied answer can be revised; one with an applied answer is changed by a superseding answer. An answer bound to the earlier revision is recorded unreconciled. word persists it through hive-pool revise-question. See spec/word.md.

recommendation.description: The option to present first. Required when options is not empty.

options.description: The recommendation and the alternatives, whole: the new revision replaces the options of the one before.
